title: Cosmic Robot Oracle
description: A small steampunk robot with large glowing blue eyes stands centered on a circular stone pedestal. Six jellyfish-like cosmic orbs with galaxy patterns and golden rings float above it, connected by ethereal tendrils, while the dark ground is scattered with lit candles, golden rings, and occult symbols against a misty purple background.
prompt: A small detailed steampunk robot with large glowing blue eyes stands on a circular stone pedestal in the center of a dark mystical scene. Six translucent jellyfish-like orbs containing galaxies, planets, and silhouetted figures float above it, each encircled by golden rings and connected to the robot by flowing ethereal tendrils. The ground around the pedestal is covered in black sand with scattered lit candles, golden rings, and occult symbols. Mystical purple and grey misty background with floating arcane symbols, in a surreal dark fantasy style.
